behavior: The parent checkbox of a group names in `aria-controls` the `id` that the element of each child has now. The owner element of a portal names in `aria-owns` the `id` that the portal element has now. Each follows a change of that `id` that no render of the part makes, such as a change that a component in the `#render` slot makes in a render of its own. An element with an empty `id` is not named. Base UI names the `id` prop of the `render` element. A component in the `render` element that gives its element another `id` thus leaves a reference that names no element.
